levels.surface: أبي الجوزاء المنبه بن عبد الله

notes: Al-Faqih states his routes («طرق») to Abu al-Jawza' with no saying (rule 11). The three groups are the routes the text names; the first (al-Faqih's father, then the book's source) is the author of a cited work, so the archive decides.
«- رضي اللّه عنهما -» blessings are excluded.
